659:t_161:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「A species that envies other living things and wishes only for its own prosperity has no future!」

659:t_161:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This is bad...! This is very bad!」

659:t_161:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This man... bears the sun within him!」

659:t_161:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'll be your opponent! Ravenous destroyers! If you do not fear the radiance of the sun, come at me!」

659:t_162:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You bastard! If you swallow us, you'll get more than a stomachache!」

659:t_162:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You need not worry, boy.」

659:t_162:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You too shall gain eternity by becoming one with us.」

659:t_162:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Like hell I want to end up looking that creepy!」

659:t_162:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Get ready, you cosmic pests! Me, $$トライダー$$, and $c are gonna exterminate you right here!」

659:t_163:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If you have minds that can think and still attack people, you're no different from criminals!」

659:t_163:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You would impose Earthlings' rules... their natural order here?」

659:t_163:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You're small-minded...! Far too small-minded, boy!」

659:t_163:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Justice defeats evil! That rule applies on Earth and throughout the universe!」

659:t_163:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't hold back, $$鉄人$$! Give them everything you've got!」

659:t_164:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「So you've come, wielder of the power of light!」

659:t_164:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Your soul and your body of steel shall all be ours! Through the power of the Great Void!」

659:t_164:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「To hell with the Great Void's power! We're alive... we exist!」

659:t_164:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go, $$マジンガー$$! We'll use our power to tear through their endless darkness!」

659:t_165:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Come, warriors of $$ゲッター線$$!」

659:t_165:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We shall settle here which of us has been chosen by $$ゲッター線$$!」

659:t_165:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's just what I want, $$インベーダー#pilot$$!」

659:t_165:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「Come to think of it, we've been dealing with these things for quite a long time.」

659:t_165:4.en:
$$弁慶$$
「For that matter, I've been with you guys a long time too.」

659:t_165:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「Too bad for you. It seems the $$ゲッター$$ team won't be disbanding even after we beat these things.」

659:t_165:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Our fight isn't over yet! We can't waste forever on bastards like these!」

659:t_165:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go, $$ゲッター$$! We'll blow their Great Void away!」

659:t_166:0.en:
$$號$$
(The Great Void... eternal darkness... It's the greatest and strongest enemy of all living things...)

659:t_166:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Damn emissary of $$ゲッター線$$! Are you helpless before our immense power?!」

659:t_166:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「If you now know your place, let yourself be absorbed into us without resistance!」

659:t_166:3.en:
$$凱$$
「Don't stand there spacing out, $$號$$! The giant $$インベーダー#pilot$$ is right in front of us!」

659:t_166:4.en:
$$渓$$
「We're counting on you, $$號$$. We've entrusted both our lives and $$ゲッター$$'s power to you!」

659:t_166:6.en:
$$號$$
「Let's do it, $$ゲッター$$! We'll overcome the Great Void to open a path to the future!」

659:t_167:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「The one who bears the essence of both light and darkness! His name is $$マーズ$$!」

659:t_167:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Half of your existence is of the same nature as our Great Void! In other words, you are one of us!」

659:t_167:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「This malice isn't theirs alone! This entire space is trying to devour every living thing!」

659:t_167:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「I won't lose! ...As long as I'm alive, I'll keep fighting for the vow I made with my brother!」

659:t_168:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「The day has finally come, $$インベーダー#pilot$$! Today, I'll settle things with you once and for all!」

659:t_168:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Spiral Man! If you too intend to challenge the $$御使い$$s, offer your power to us!」

659:t_168:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Then we shall have a chance to defeat them! That is our hope!」

659:t_168:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「I refuse! My comrades and I will fight the $$御使い$$s without borrowing your damn power!」

659:t_168:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here I come! My drill will pierce through your nonsensical logic and your ambitions all at once!」

659:t_169:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$バアル$$...! They're humanity's natural enemies...!」

659:t_169:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Can you win? Our power is beyond comparison with those incarnations of endless destruction you fought!」

659:t_169:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We are the emissaries of the Great Void... of the force that seeks to vanish! We shall remake this universe!」

659:t_169:3.en:
$$カズミ$$
「If they're calling themselves $$バアル$$, you needn't hold back, $$ノリコ$$!」

659:t_169:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$'s mission is to protect humanity! We'll be your opponents!」

659:t_170:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You aren't $$バアル$$, but you turned out to be $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_170:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You aren't $$バアル$$, but you turned out to be $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_170:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「You aren't $$バアル$$, but you turned out to be $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_170:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「At this point, we care nothing for the name $$バアル$$!」

659:t_170:4.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We shall devour everything! You, the $$御使い$$s, and this universe!」

659:t_170:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ won't hold back against opponents like that! Because...!」

659:t_170:6.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ won't hold back against opponents like that! Because...!」

659:t_170:7.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ won't hold back against opponents like that! Because...!」

659:t_170:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$! $$ノノ$$ is the power meant to protect humanity from the $$バアル$$!」

659:t_170:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$! $$ノノ$$ is the power meant to protect humanity from the $$バアル$$!」

659:t_170:10.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$! $$ノノ$$ is the power meant to protect humanity from the $$バアル$$!」

659:t_171:0.en:
$$葵$$
「Just knowing this will be the last time I see your disgusting faces gives me extra strength!」

659:t_171:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Ugly?! You call our forms ugly?!」

659:t_171:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Impossible! We are the species with the strongest power in the universe! Power itself should be beauty!」

659:t_171:3.en:
$$葵$$
「Our tastes and everything else really are way too different!」

659:t_171:4.en:
$$葵$$
「I'm ending this here, $$インベーダー#pilot$$! Let's do this!!」

659:t_172:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You salarymen who do not know your place! You sealed your fate by blundering all the way out into the galaxy!」

659:t_172:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But even that recklessness is power! Become one with us!」

659:t_172:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「We're not interested in a merger! We're humans who cry, laugh, and do our damnedest to live!」

659:t_172:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「You take lives with your selfish logic! We're stopping you here! That's our duty... our duty as humans!!」

659:t_173:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's unfortunate. We can indeed communicate with you, but there is no reasoning with you.」

659:t_173:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「That cannot be helped. Earthlings could hardly understand our words.」

659:t_173:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But you need not worry. Once you become one with us, there will be no problems.」

659:t_173:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm telling you that your selfish, coercive logic isn't worth discussing.」

659:t_173:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Therefore, I'll follow your methods! Things will get rough, but consider this your own doing!」

659:t_174:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「We're alive...! Everyone wants to live!」

659:t_174:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If you're going to take that away...! Then to protect everyone, I'll...!」

659:t_174:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「It is useless, boy. What can one human do?」

659:t_174:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But the artificial human you pilot is appealing. We very much desire its power!」

659:t_174:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I won't... hand over the EVA! It's all I have left!」

659:t_175:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「To hell with the Great Void! We're alive, and we'll blow that thing away!」

659:t_175:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Your bluster, at least, is impressive, boy.」
